expert_rss.summary:
Gaza authorities said that seven people were killed in Israeli strikes Saturday that also damaged a hospital's medical supplies, a day after Hamas said it agreed to the latest stage of a deal to end the war.

expert_rss.title: Israel's Smotrich says 'complete victory' is Gaza's resettlement
expert_rss.summary:
Israel's Smotrich says 'complete victory' is Gaza's resettlement 

    
    

        
    
                Speaking on a podcast, far-right Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich says for him, “complete victory” means the resettling of the Gaza Strip.
